build_QwenImageTransformer2DModel: build a QwenImageTransformer2DModel with custom patch size, attention heads, and number of layers for image generation
run_QwenImageTransformer2DModel_forward: run the forward pass of QwenImageTransformer2DModel with hidden states, encoder hidden states, and timestep inputs
create_QwenEmbedRope: create a QwenEmbedRope module with configurable theta and axes dimensions for 3D rotary positional embeddings
apply_apply_rotary_emb_qwen: apply rotary embeddings to query or key tensors using precomputed frequency tensors with real or complex modes
compute_get_timestep_embedding: compute sinusoidal timestep embeddings for diffusion model denoising steps with configurable embedding dimension and scaling
